name: Metric Yang Obstruction Vanishes on Dismantlable Ample Families
scope: Every finite nonempty dismantlable ample family, with the singleton normalization from the invariant definition.
proof: A corner-peeling order is a distance-preserving elimination order, so its chamber lies outside the union of the metric failure subcomplexes. That union is therefore a proper subcomplex of the order sphere and has zero top homology.
